title: feat(console): Connect an AI Assistant names the connected assistant and its last call; plain-words page subtitle
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XUajPDb8jMKTWyncZpJ2wTS)_

Fixes #30898

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:「连接 AI 助手」页示例请求下方那一行,在本人已连接后改为说明连的是哪个助手(或哪把 API 密钥)、最近一次调用是什么时候;没连接时仍是「先试第一条」。页头副标题去掉 MCP、行级安全等协议词,改成大白话。
- 为什么改:卡 #30898 期望 2 与期望 3 的剩余部分:连接之后回到页面应能看出连接成功了;页头仍在说「支持 MCP 的 AI 客户端」。
- 风险与回滚:只读两份已有记录(本人已授权的助手、本人的 API 密钥),不新增服务端接口;读失败时退回「先试第一条」,绝不误报「未连接」。回滚即还原本 PR,无数据迁移。
- 先看:ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/connect/connectedAccess.ts(「已连接」的唯一判定与排序)、ConnectAgentWidget.tsx 的 ConnectedStatus、ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts(新增 6 个键)。
- 两分钟验证:pnpm dev 后以授权过助手或建过 API 密钥的用户打开 账户 → 连接 AI 助手,示例请求下方显示「已连接:Claude Desktop。最近一次调用在 … 起的那一小时内。」;撤销后该行回到「先试第一条」。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **The Connected line** (`ConnectAgentWidget.tsx`, `ConnectedStatus`). Under the example requests, once the signed-in person has connected, the page names what is connected and when it last made a call, the most recent call first:
  - an authorized assistant by its name ("Connected: Claude Desktop."), with its last call "in the hour from" the recorded hour, because the server records `lastUsedAt` as the start of an hour;
  - an API key by its name ("Connected with the API key "doubao key"."), with its last call as a moment (`last_used_at`);
  - "No call yet: ask it the first request above to check the connection." when nothing is recorded;
  - one more line pointing to the list at the bottom of the page when more than one thing is connected.
  With nothing connected the line stays the try-first hint PR #31052 shipped. While the read is out the line draws nothing, so it does not flip after a moment.
- **One "has connected" read** (`connectedAccess.ts`, `useConnectedAccess`). It reads only the records the "What can act as you" list already reads: `oauth.authorizedClients.list()` and the person's own `sys_api_key` rows (filtered to `user_id`, as the list does). A revoked key or one past `expires_at` is not a connection. A failed read is never reported as "nothing connected": with the other read empty the answer is `unknown` (the page shows the try-first hint), and with the other read holding a connection that one is named. The combining rule is the exported pure function `combineConnectedReads`. #30895's Home card and checklist row are meant to read this same hook. No new server route.
- **It follows the page's own Revoke.** An API-key revoke already announces `sys_api_key` on the data bus. The assistants list's withdraw now announces `sys_oauth_consent` (the record a grant is) after every withdraw, answered or refused, so the Connected line reads again.
- `accessRecords.ts` (new): the `sys_api_key` columns, the `ApiKeyRow` / `AuthorizedClient` types and the expiry rule, moved out of `AuthorizedAccessList.tsx` so the list and the hook share them (the list keeps exporting components only, so it adds no react-refresh warning).
- **Page subtitle** (Expected 3 leftover, wording only): `packages/mcp/src/connect-ui.ts` now reads "Work in this system from Claude, Doubao and other AI assistants. Each one acts as you: it sees and changes only what your own permissions allow." `pages.connect_agent.subtitle` follows in en, es-ES, ja-JP, zh-CN and zh-Hant, and the four translated locales' source digests are re-recorded (`collectSourceHashes(en)` gives `51c467af44024a1b`).
- **Language packs**, all eleven: `connectAgent.capabilities.connected`, `connectedKey`, `lastCallHour`, `lastCallAt`, `noCallYet`, `moreConnected` added; no existing key reworded or removed. `zh-Hant` regenerated from `zh-Hans` with `gen:zh-hant`.
- Changeset `.changeset/30898-connect-agent-connected-line.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `@objectstack/mcp`, `@objectstack/platform-objects`: patch).

## Why

The card's Expected 2: "Once the person has connected, the page says so: which assistant, and when it last made a call. With nothing connected yet, it says what to try first." It waited on #30894, which closed today with the authorized-assistants read and Revoke. Expected 3 left the page-header subtitle saying "MCP-capable AI client" and "row-level security".

## Tests

- `ConnectAgentWidget.connected-30898.test.tsx`, 14 cases, rendering the whole page and driving the real controls: §1 nothing connected (no grants, only a revoked and an expired key) keeps the try-first line and reads only the person's own keys; §2 an assistant is named with its hour, a nameless one by the fallback, "no call yet" when none is recorded; §3 the most recent call wins (a key that called after every assistant is named as an API key at its moment; a revoked key that called later still is not named; more than one points to the list); §4 a failed read falls back to the try-first line, or still names what the other read found; §5 clicking Revoke and confirming, on the only assistant and on the only key, turns the line back to the try-first hint; §6 `combineConnectedReads` on its own (loading, unknown, not connected only when both answered empty, ordering).
- `ConnectAgentWidget.keyName-13355.test.tsx`: the capability-key list pin gains the six keys, so every pack must carry each of them and none may be an English copy.
- `de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts`: 109 → 110 paired „…“ spans, for `connectAgent.capabilities.connectedKey` („{{name}}“), recorded in the pin's history comment as earlier additions were.
- Ablations (one-off, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored blob equal to HEAD each time): deleting the withdraw's `notifyDataChanged({ objectName: 'sys_oauth_consent', … })` turned §5's assistant case red (1 failed, 13 passed); replacing the dead-key filter with `rows.map(keyEntry)` turned six cases red (6 failed, 8 passed).

## Acceptance notes

- **"Last call" exists on both records**, so nothing is invented: `lastUsedAt` on an authorized assistant (the start of the hour, which is why the line says "in the hour from") and `last_used_at` on an API key.
- **An API key counts as a connection.** The card names "an authorization or an API key the person holds" for #30895's checklist row, and the order reads both records; a key is named as an API key, so a CI key reads as what it is.
- **The page now reads both lists twice** (the Connected line and the list at the bottom each read them once). The list was left as PR #31084 shipped it; the cost is one more `GET /auth/authorized-clients` and one more `sys_api_key` find on this page.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is the seat's measured arm for new catalogue keys in the published `@object-ui/i18n`; no key is removed.

## Verification

<details><summary>Live, showcase on this branch (Vite console against it), admin and member, en and zh</summary>

- Administrator, en, after minting "doubao key" and calling `GET /api/v1/meta/objects` with it (200): page header "Work in this system from Claude, Doubao and other AI assistants. Each one acts as you: it sees and changes only what your own permissions allow."; Connected line "Connected with the API key "doubao key". Its last call was at Nov 7, 2026, 4:22 PM."
- Administrator, zh: header 「在 Claude、豆包等 AI 助手里使用本系统。助手始终以你的身份操作：只能查看和修改你有权限的内容。」; line 「已用 API 密钥“doubao key”连接。最近一次调用在 2026年11月7日 16:22。」
- Member (created with `admin/create-user`, password changed), en, nothing connected: no Connected line; the try-first line is shown.
- Member with one grant: the `sys_oauth_application` and `sys_oauth_consent` rows were written straight into the dev database (Claude Desktop, `last_used_at` 16:00), not through an OAuth flow; `GET /auth/authorized-clients` then answered that grant. zh: 「已连接：Claude Desktop。最近一次调用在 2026年11月7日 16:00 起的那一小时内。」 en, then Revoke on its row and confirm in the dialog: the Connected line left, the try-first line came back, and `GET /auth/authorized-clients` answered `[]`.

</details>

<details><summary>Local tests and gates</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/connect/ packages/i18n/ packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/product-neutral-renderer.ratchet.test.ts`: 102 files passed, 1832 tests passed, 13 skipped (head a93d7f24; later commits touch only the changeset).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` and `@object-ui/i18n` type-check: exit 0. eslint on `console/connect/`: 0 errors, 3 warnings (all existing, in `ConnectAgentWidget.tsx`'s untouched `any`s). ui `check:new-line-citations`: 0 new.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test`: 119 files, 1656 passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp test`: 60 files, 767 passed.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 66 families; all 66 exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 66 derived, 66 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Two needed a second run: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` was SIGKILLed by the box's memory limit on the first pass and then passed (170 files, 2 skipped); `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` answered exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET (seven packages without dist) until they were built, then exit 0. The changeset families and `check:nul-bytes` were re-run on the final head 7005f763, all exit 0.

</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No spec change.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; eslint on the touched files passes (the repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
